description:
This video was made possible thanks to everyone on the Simple History Patreon: https://www.patreon.com/simplehistory

Crew of six. Two loaders at the back of the turret, gunner and commander up front, all trying not to get hit by recoil. Then they sealed it up and drove 25 feet underwater using power from another tank.
What other cramped WWII vehicle should we cover next?
